proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness denotes a measurable relational property that inheres in an agent or a collective of agents — the degree or mode by which agents are connected to one another or to an institution. As a property that can vary in degree and inheres in a bearer, Quality (BFO_0000019) is the most defensible BFO home. It is not a process (it is not an event unfolding in time), not a role (it is not externally grounded in a social position), and not a disposition (it need not be a capacity to behave in some way). It is a structural-relational property of agents, best captured as a Quality.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is a subclass of Quality (BFO_0000019) because it is a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in one or more agents and characterises the relational property of their being connected.

open_questions: Is 'agent connectedness' intended as a dyadic relational quality between two specific agents, or as a collective property of a group or institution (e.g., network cohesion)?
Should AgentConnectedness be modeled as a subclass of RelationalCoherence (already in the ontology as a Quality) rather than directly under BFO Quality, given thematic overlap?
Is agent connectedness a disposition (a capacity or tendency to coordinate) rather than a static quality? If it has a causal/functional character, BFO_0000016 (Disposition) may be more appropriate.
Does 'agent' here refer to human persons, legal persons, software agents, or all of the above? This affects which bearer class should be related via RO_0000052 (inheres in).
proposal.rationale_summary: The user asks to classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity. Because the phrase denotes a relational property — the state or degree to which agents are connected — it is most naturally typed as a Quality (BFO_0000019), a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in a bearer and is measurable or characterisable. It is not a process, not a role, and not paradigmatically a disposition (unless the intent is a causal capacity to form connections, which would shift it to BFO_0000016). The existing class RelationalCoherence is also typed as a Quality and is thematically adjacent; the user should clarify whether AgentConnectedness should be a sibling or a specialisation of that class. The proposal mints AgentConnectedness as a new Quality subclass pending that clarification.
